notes: Authored dungeons, set 2 of 2 (Plan 6 D5): ten dungeons on maps from the _haunted, _coastal, __dungeon entrances and _epic (n-z) folders. Each map path is relative to ~/dnd5e and listed in assets.manifest.txt (local assets only). Rooms were marked by looking at each map: coordinates are [x, y] fractions of the image, in delve order, and every room's text and situations follow what is drawn there. The last room is the climax. Room situations live in dungeon-rooms-2.json. All descriptions are our own words. Written by Claude.

entries.name: The Ashgrave Mausoleum
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_haunted/Afternoon Maps is creating RPG and DnD battlemaps _ Patreon.jpeg
entries.summary: A family mausoleum below a ruined chapel, where the last of the line did not stay buried.

rooms.name: The Coffin Hall
rooms.text: At the foot of the stair, a long vault of coffins on stone biers between two rows of pillars, with urn niches in the walls and doors to two side vaults.

rooms.name: The East Vault
rooms.text: A side vault with coffins along its walls, a bronze seal in the floor, and iron-bound chests stacked by the far wall.

rooms.name: The Hall of Niches
rooms.text: Up a broad stair, a pillared hall walled with burial niches. On a red-draped dais at the back stands the family altar.

rooms.name: The Founder's Tomb
rooms.text: At the end of a narrow passage, a chamber with a carved sarcophagus on a plinth and a shrine against the wall. Part of the ceiling has fallen in at the corner.

hoard.text: The founder's grave goods: a silver circlet, rings on bony fingers and a purse of old coin.

entries.name: The Greyvein Lead Mine
entries.summary: An old lead mine shut after a cave-in, now a den for what crawled up from below.

rooms.name: The Adit Mouth
rooms.text: The mine's mouth: an ore cart tipped on its side, a rusted bucket, and a shovel left where it fell. Fresh tracks lead in.

rooms.name: The Flooded Gallery
rooms.text: A long channel of still green water fills the western gallery, with a rowboat tied at its foot below some plank steps.

rooms.name: The Collapsed Face
rooms.text: The northern working ends in a rockfall: a heap of boulders and snapped pit-props under a leaning timber hoist.

rooms.name: The Ore Pocket
rooms.text: A side cave where yellow-crusted ore lies in heaps and the walls glitter.

rooms.name: The Sinkhole
rooms.text: The east gallery opens around a black sinkhole, its edge propped with old timbers and a ladder lashed to the far wall.

hoard.text: The miners' strongbox, dragged down into the sinkhole: wages in silver and a few silver ingots from the last good seam.

entries.name: Wyrmprow Cove
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_coastal/abandoned pirate cove.jpg
entries.summary: A smugglers' sea cave where a dragon-prowed ship broke on the rocks, and its captain never left.

rooms.name: The Wreck
rooms.text: A ship lies broken on the fang-like rocks of the cove, its carved dragon prow reaching for the sand.

rooms.name: The Candlelit Strand
rooms.text: Broad sand flats split by a tidal channel, with stubs of black candles burning in the sand.

rooms.name: The Violet Grotto
rooms.text: A side cave lit violet, with something small and pale at the heart of the light.

rooms.name: The Bone Nest
rooms.text: Up the stream that feeds the cove, a heap of picked bones and stones makes a nest, with a clutch of pale eggs beside it.

rooms.name: The Captain's Cache
rooms.text: A ledge above the cove, reached along a ridge of kelp-hung roots. Chests and spilled coin lie heaped there, round an upright box like a coffin.

hoard.text: The captain's chests: salt-crusted coin, a box of pearls and a brass spyglass with a dragon on its barrel.

entries.name: The Starfloor Crypt
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_haunted/crypt with traps.jpeg
entries.summary: The trapped crypt of a star-reading priesthood, where every star in the floor is a trigger.

rooms.name: The Coffin Gallery
rooms.text: A long gallery with two rows of stone coffins, and a bronze star set in the floor of a side alcove.

rooms.name: The Offering Passage
rooms.text: A narrow passage lined with coffin niches, with a side chamber holding an offering table and steps up to a sealed annex.

rooms.name: The Pit Hall
rooms.text: A hall whose floor is broken by four round shafts, with star sigils by its doors.

rooms.name: The Star Chapel
rooms.text: A chapel ringed with sarcophagi in wall alcoves around a great star sigil. The north wall has caved in.

rooms.name: The Great Vault
rooms.text: A vast vault with a raised half-moon dais holding twin sarcophagi between two star sigils. Cracked green slabs lie strewn from a round iron grate in the floor.

hoard.text: Star charts in silver cases, the priests' rings, and a golden astrolabe from the twin sarcophagi.

entries.name: The Gilded Grottoes
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_coastal/cavern sea-trapped encampment.jpeg
entries.summary: Sea caves where a shipwrecked crew camped among glowing golden spawn, until the thing that laid them came back.

rooms.name: The Anchor Cove
rooms.text: A lantern-lit nook of sand where a huge broken anchor lies half-buried, ringed with bones and scattered belongings.

rooms.name: The Stranded Camp
rooms.text: Torn canvas lean-tos round cold fire pits: the camp of a crew that waited for a ship that never came.

rooms.name: The Golden Lagoon
rooms.text: A dark lagoon lit from within by heaps of round golden pods piled on its shallows.

rooms.name: The Whale's Ribs
rooms.text: At the end of a tidal channel lies the skeleton of a whale, its ribs a cage on the sand.

rooms.name: The Amber Grotto
rooms.text: A carved stair, lit by lanterns set in the rock, runs down to a still black pool. At its head something glows through a web of cracks.

hoard.text: The lantern-keepers' offerings round the cracked egg: gold rings, pearls, and a carved amber idol.

entries.name: The Drowned Keep
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_haunted/abandoned dungeon overtaken by water and ghosts.jpeg
entries.summary: A sunken fortress the river broke into, where the garrison still keeps its watch as ghosts.

rooms.name: The Flooded Stair
rooms.text: A rubble-choked guardroom at the foot of a stair, black water to the knee and stones fallen from the vault.

rooms.name: The Pillared Cistern
rooms.text: A square hall of four pillars, its floor under still water.

rooms.name: The Pale Chapel
rooms.text: A long pillared chamber lit pale and cold, with a side apse and steps down to the south.

rooms.name: The High Hall
rooms.text: A raised hall of four pillars up a short stair, with a deep alcove behind it. Rubble has slid in through a broken wall.

rooms.name: The River Breach
rooms.text: The keep's great hall, two pillars standing in green water. Its east wall is burst open, and the roar of the underground river fills it.

hoard.text: The keep's pay chest, sunk in the great hall: coin of a dead kingdom, a silver seal and the castellan's ring.

entries.name: Stormwrack Manor
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_haunted/manor of horrors 34x61.jpg
entries.summary: A noble house on a storm-lashed crag, whose lady made a bargain with a chained fire-idol.

rooms.name: The Statue Vestibule
rooms.text: A dark entry hall between carved guardian statues, a torn red runner leading to a short stair.

rooms.name: The Shrouded Parlour
rooms.text: East of the vestibule, a parlour whose sofas and chairs all stand under grey dust sheets, with fresh candles burning in the sconces.

rooms.name: The Laboratory
rooms.text: A side room where a long table on a red cloth is crowded with flasks, alembics and bottled things.

rooms.name: The Hearth Hall
rooms.text: The heart of the lower house: a great hearth carved as a snarling face, its fire burning without wood.

rooms.name: The West Rooms
rooms.text: Two bedchambers in the west wing: a red daybed and a writing desk heaped with letters in one, a bed and a white bearskin rug in the other.

rooms.name: The Covered Bridge
rooms.text: A roofed stone bridge over the chasm between the lower house and the gallery hall, half its roof torn away by the storm.

rooms.name: The Gallery Hall
rooms.text: Across the covered bridge, a long hall ringed by a pillared gallery. Crates are piled round a sheet-draped shape, and a barred cell stands in one corner.

rooms.name: The Idol Apse
rooms.text: Up a stair, a round apse where a great horned idol glows like a furnace in a sunken ring, hung with chains and laid round with rugs.

hoard.text: The family's treasure, laid as offerings at the idol's feet: jewelled cups, a casket of gems and a ring that is still warm.

entries.name: The Skullmire
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/__dungeon entrances/swamp black dragon lair.jpg
entries.summary: A black dragon's lair in the mire, behind a causeway that ends in a giant carved skull.

rooms.name: The Drowned Causeway
rooms.text: Stepping stones run through black water toward the skull, between tusks and ribs sticking up from the mire.

rooms.name: The Boneyard
rooms.text: A grassy hummock heaped with the bones of great beasts, beside a toppled rune-carved pillar.

rooms.name: The Skull's Jaw
rooms.text: The causeway ends at the jaw of a giant carved skull, its stone teeth dripping with slime.

rooms.name: The Burning Brow
rooms.text: On the skull's brow, a golden sigil burns in a ring of carved stone beside the bones of two thieves.

rooms.name: The Lair Mouth
rooms.text: Behind the skull, between two carved pillars, a cave opens in the rock. The air from it stings the eyes.

hoard.text: The dragon's hoard, half sunk in acid-etched mud: heaps of coin, gems gone dull, and a crown nobody has worn for an age.

entries.name: The Vault of the Ape King
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_epic/__zatnikotel-maps/_lost temple of the monkey king/map_2_puzzles_grid_by_zatnikotel_dd2b587.jpg
entries.summary: The buried temple of a forgotten ape king, built over a smoking gulf and guarded by puzzles.

rooms.name: The Smoking Rings
rooms.text: A chain of round stone chambers joined by short bridges over a gulf of smoke and glowing cracks.

rooms.name: The Great Ring
rooms.text: The largest of the round chambers, at the west end of the gulf, where the smoke pools thickest and a long stair climbs north out of it.

rooms.name: The Golden Stair
rooms.text: At the top of a long stair, a hall lit gold by braziers, with four round pedestals round a lidded altar.

rooms.name: The Sphere Room
rooms.text: A narrow chamber with three great stone balls heaped in a corner, and grooves worn in the floor.

rooms.name: The Hall of Spouts
rooms.text: A long hall with a trench down its middle and round holes along both walls at knee height. A round grate closes its far end.

rooms.name: The Knotted Floor
rooms.text: Beyond a long hall of alcoves, a room whose floor is studded with stone knobs like a game board.

rooms.name: The Blue Well
rooms.text: An eight-sided chamber round a well of cold blue light, the heart of the temple.

hoard.text: The King's tribute, drawn up from the well: a gold crown, carved jade, and a staff topped with a blue stone.

entries.name: The Greenwyrm Falls
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/__dungeon entrances/forest green dragon lair.jpg
entries.summary: Overgrown ruins along a forest stream, climbing to the pool where an ancient green dragon sleeps.

rooms.name: The Broken Bridge
rooms.text: A ruined stone bridge across the stream, its arches tumbled into the water and strangled by roots.

rooms.name: The Fallen Shrine
rooms.text: A great roofless building beside the stream, its walls falling outward and moss over its floor.

rooms.name: The Toppled Tower
rooms.text: A tower that fell across the bank long ago, now a ramp of broken stone into the canopy.

rooms.name: The Falls
rooms.text: The stream pours over a stone lip from the pool above in a white curtain of water.

rooms.name: The Wyrm's Pool
rooms.text: A wide green pool cupped in tiers of ancient stone, with dead branches sunk in its water.

hoard.text: The wyrm's hoard, drowned among the roots of her pool: coin by the chestful, a jewelled harp, loose gems and an elven circlet.
